sn45.30:1.2: atha kho āyasmā uttiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā uttiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn45.30:1.3: idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn45.30:1.5: katame nu kho pañca kāmaguṇā vuttā bhagavatāti.
sn45.30:1.7: pañca khome uttiya kāmaguṇā vuttā mayā.
sn45.30:1.9: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn45.30:1.13: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn45.30:1.14: ame kho uttiya pañca kāmaguṇā vuttā mayā.
sn45.30:1.15: imesaṃ kho uttiya pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
sn45.30:1.18: imesaṃ kho uttiya pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
